# StateTests skip list: fixtures that are not run at all.

# Only list fixtures that cannot run: ones that abort the VM or cannot finish.
# Fixtures that run but fail belong in known_failures.txt instead.

# - test/fixtures/state_tests/ethereum-tests/GeneralStateTests/some/path/file.json

# - test_name

# Too slow to finish: each case below runs past the 60 s per-case timeout
# (a 10M-iteration Solidity loop, max-round BLAKE2F). They are speed problems,
# not known wrong results. Running them costs most of the suite's wall time and
# makes CI timing-dependent, so they are not run. Re-enable as the interpreter
# gets faster; `mix bench state_fixtures` times loopMul (142 s after #193,
# https://github.com/mw2000/eevm/issues/208).
test/fixtures/state_tests/ethereum-tests/GeneralStateTests/VMTests/vmPerformance/loopMul.json
test/fixtures/state_tests/ethereum-tests/GeneralStateTests/stTimeConsuming/CALLBlake2f_MaxRounds.json

# Too slow on CI since SHA-256 became pure Elixir (#194): 50,000 STATICCALLs
# that each hash 50,000 bytes take about 159 s per case on CI against the
# 180 s timeout. Re-enable when a case takes under half the timeout there:
# https://github.com/mw2000/eevm/issues/201
